title: Four triggers, two lands
story: I tapped my Forest for green and cast Crop Rotation , sacrificing the Forest as the spell's additional cost. I searched for The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale and put it onto the battlefield. My opponent had Delver of Secrets , Young Pyromancer , two Elemental tokens, and only two mana-producing lands. At the beginning of their next upkeep, all four creatures had a payment trigger. My opponent paid {1} to keep Delver and {1} to keep Pyromancer. Both Elemental tokens were destroyed when their unpaid triggers resolved. Tabernacle never tapped. Neither token was sacrificed, and I had not cast a sweeper.

review.basis: The historical 2015 Jarvis Yu Lands deck contains Forest, Crop Rotation and Tabernacle; fictional Grixis Delver opponent holds Delver of Secrets, Young Pyromancer and two previously generated tokens. Forest taps for green and is sacrificed to pay the additional Crop Rotation cost. Four upkeep abilities are granted to the opponent's four creatures and controlled by that opponent; the two mana sources pay {1} for two creatures, and unpaid tokens are destroyed without sacrifice. The Tabernacle itself is never activated or tapped and generates no mana.
